claude.windows:
Claude Code CLI not found. Install it first.

Install: npm install -g {'@'}anthropic-ai/claude-code

On Windows the executable is usually `%APPDATA%\npm\claude.cmd`; if it still isn't detected, make sure that directory is on PATH.
claude.unix:
Claude Code CLI not found. Install it first.

Install: npm install -g {'@'}anthropic-ai/claude-code

Node.js is required first.

codex.unix: Codex CLI not found. Install it first and make sure the `codex` command is on PATH.

gemini.windows: Gemini CLI not found. Install it first and make sure `gemini` is available.

permissionHint.claude: When enabled, new or resumed sessions automatically include --dangerously-skip-permissions.
permissionHint.codex: When enabled, Codex automatically includes --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox, starting with the loosest permissions.
permissionHint.gemini: When enabled, Gemini automatically includes -y (YOLO mode), skipping all tool confirmations.
permissionHint.workbuddy: WorkBuddy resumes by opening the WorkBuddy app; no permission flags are involved.
permissionHint.dsh: DSH sessions live on the web and cannot be resumed in a local terminal.
permissionHint.opencode: OpenCode sessions are browsed read-only; no permission flags are involved.
permissionHint.grok: Grok session resume does not involve additional permission flags.
